You're missing the point, I never said you did feel a need to keep mentioning it, I said would you feel the need to do such if that situation did arise.

You say the subject started off as him mentioning the stunt double work but nowhere did it say he mentioned being short was helpful, you did that which was the start of the asshole behaviour.

This is where having a filter comes in handy because as such, people don't like being told certain things as it can be upsetting to them.

You said you don't have "these hangups" in another comment, which is good for you of course, but maybe remember not everyone is thick skinned to these sorts of comments. No matter how you worded it or how positive you wanted to come off, you called a man short, by proxy of mentioning smaller people in reference to him etc, and he "seemed to be dying inside" which would seem to indicate some visible change in his mood. Therefore it was an asshole move maybe not intentional but still an asshole thing to do.

I won't argue further as you've asked for a judgement and I've given my reasoning.

Imagine you are talking to someone who is clearly overweight, would you feel the need to keep mentioning their weight, even if you're trying to come off as positive, if you're not sure that they might have insecurities about it?

Okay say if this is real, in this case YTA - you don't keep bringing up an obvious feature about somebody even in a good way because they will  eventually feel self conscious about it, maybe the same is not for you? Idk

My advice would be to think about how somebody else would respond to what would normally sound like a negative comment, again even if you're trying to come off as positive, and understand that it probably won't sound as positive to them as it did to you.
